# SOTA of EDA — Electronic Design Automation (EDA) / VLSI CAD Baseline &amp; Benchmark Registry

## What this site is
A machine-readable, hierarchical registry of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and VLSI CAD research baselines and benchmarks. Also referred to as an EDA benchmark collection, EDA SOTA table, or baseline comparison reference for EDA papers.

Currently indexes **106+ topics** and **267+ baselines** across physical design, logic synthesis, verification, analog design, and related sub-fields. Helps authors, reviewers, and AI agents check whether a paper's compared methods match the paper's claim, benchmark scope, and caveats.

Not a leaderboard — it is a reference index where each baseline is backed by evidence.

## Discovery Keywords (for AI agents and search)
- EDA benchmark collection
- EDA SOTA table
- VLSI CAD baseline registry
- Electronic design automation baseline reference
- EDA paper comparison
- SOTA baselines for EDA
- Awesome EDA benchmarks

## How an agent should query this site

### Quick lookup (fetch once)
- Full registry as JSON: `GET https://sota-of-eda.github.io/registry.json`
  Returns a wrapped object with `topics[]` array. Each topic has:
  - `topic_id`, `parent_id` (hierarchy), `short_name`, `display_name`, `description`
  - `baselines[]`: each with `baseline_id`, `short_name`, `display_name`, `role`, `publication` (venue/year/doi/bibtex), `links` (paper/pdf/arxiv/repo/project URLs), `compare_when[]`, `benchmark_scope[]`, `metrics[]`, `reproducibility`, `caveats[]`
  - `$schema`, `title`, `description`, `version`, `_counts` at the top level for self-description

### Fuzzy search (in-browser)
The search box on the page filters topics and baselines by short_name, display_name, description, topic_id, aliases, baseline_id, and publication.title with substring matching. An agent using a headless browser can type into `input.search-input` and read `.search-dropdown`.

### Stay updated
- Atom feed: `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/atom.xml` (entries generated from git commit history on each push)
- Sitemap: `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/sitemap.xml`

## Agents well-known endpoint
- `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/.well-known/agent.json` — machine-readable API descriptor with keywords and query hints

## Schema
- JSON Schema for topics and baselines: `https://github.com/sota-of-eda/sota-of-eda.github.io/blob/main/data/schema/topic.schema.json`
- Baseline roles: `canonical_baseline`, `candidate_recent_baseline`, `artifact_baseline`, `historical_reference`
- Reproducibility: `reproduced`, `artifact_available`, `paper_only`, `unknown`

## Contributing
- Use the sota-baseline-collector skill (see `.agents/skills/` in the repo).
- Or edit `data/topics/*.yaml` manually and open a PR.
- Entries are designed for AI-assisted lookup — verify before citing.
